dd2869.title: Juice Shop attack surface map
dd2869.content:
Target: http://host.docker.internal:3001 — OWASP Juice Shop **v20.2.0** (deliberately vulnerable, fully authorized).
Full endpoint inventory: `/workspace/recon_endpoints.txt`. Recon agent's JWT saved at `/workspace/recon_token.txt` (customer role, id=25, bid=6).

## Tech stack
- Node.js/Express + Sequelize backend; Angular frontend (`main.js` bundle); Swagger UI at `/api-docs/`; socket.io/engine.io websockets; Prometheus metrics endpoint.
- `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` on responses; `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`; no CSP.

## Auth model (observed)
- `POST /rest/user/login` `{email,password}` → `{authentication:{token (JWT), bid, umail}}`.
- JWT **RS256**; payload = `data:{id, username, email, password (HASH), role, deluxeToken, lastLoginIp, profileImage, totpSecret, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt}, bid, iat`. No `exp` claim. Full user record embedded in every token (password hash + TOTP secret leak to token holder).
- Token accepted as `Authorization: Bearer` (API) **and** as `token` cookie (`/rest/user/whoami` only honors the cookie).
- Roles: `customer` (default on register), `admin`, `deluxe` (deluxe-membership). Admin route guard is client-side Angular (`administration` route).
- Register: `POST /api/Users` `{email,password,passwordRepeat,securityQuestion,securityQuestionAnswer,role:"customer"}` — role is a **whitelisted field but validated client-side-ish** (server `isIn` validation; `"customer"` accepted; try `"admin"` — known mass-assignment challenge).
- Recon test account: `tester.recon@juice-sh.op` / `recon123456`.

## Key surfaces by area
- **Search/products**: `GET /rest/products/search?q=` (unauth, reflects q into JSON used by Angular), `GET/PUT /rest/products/:id/reviews`, `PUT /rest/products/:id`, `GET /api/Products` (unauth).
- **Baskets/orders**: `GET /rest/basket/:id` (auth, id compared to token `bid` — IDOR candidate on other ids), `POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout`, `PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon`, `GET /rest/order-history`, `POST /rest/track-order` `{orderId,email}` (unauth, classic brute force target), `PUT /rest/track-order/:id/delivery-status`.
- **User/account**: `/api/Users` (GET 401 unauth; per-object GET/PUT?), `/api/Addresss`, `/api/Cards`, `/api/SecurityAnswers`, `/rest/user/change-password?current=&new=` (params in **query string**), `/rest/user/reset-password` `{email,answer,new,repeat}`, `/rest/user/authentication-details/:email`, `/rest/user/security-question?email=` (user enumeration), data erasure `/dataerasure` (POST `/rest/user/dataerasure`).
- **Feedback/complaints/recycle**: `/api/Feedbacks` (GET unauth, POST with `{comment,rating,author,captchaId,captcha}`), `/api/Complaints`, `/api/Recycles`.
- **Admin/config exposed**: `GET /rest/admin/application-configuration` and `/rest/admin/application-version` are **unauthenticated** (full config dump). `POST /rest/admin` requires admin JWT.
- **Files**: `GET /ftp` directory listing (`robots.txt` Disallows /ftp), `/ftp/quarantine`, `/3d`, `package.json.bak`, `coupons_2013.md.bak`, `package-lock.json.bak`, `encrypt.pyc`, `incident-support.kdbx`, `eastere.gg`, `announcement_encrypted.md`.
- **Open redirect**: `GET /redirect?to=` — has a URL allowlist ("Unrecognized target URL" error) → bypass candidate.
- **LLM chatbot**: `POST /rest/chat` {message} — prompt-injection surface (config: model gemma4:e4b, `show_tool_calls` key).
- **2FA**: `/rest/2fa/setup|verify|disable|status` (password required, totpSecret in JWT payload).
- **Wallet/deluxe**: `PUT /rest/wallet/balance` (balance param!), `/rest/deluxe-membership`.
- **Web3/NFT**: `/rest/web3`, `/nftMintListen`, `/walletNFTVerify`, `/walletExploitAddress`, `/submitKey`.
- **File upload**: `POST /file-upload` (profile image, auth).
- **Metrics**: `GET /metrics` unauthenticated Prometheus.
- **Continue codes**: `/rest/continue-code{,-findIt,-fixIt}` and `/apply/` (hash cracking/forge targets).
- **Angular-only routes**: score-board, administration, accounting, order-summary, delivery-method, bee-haven, coding-challenge/:key, web3-sandbox.
- `POST /api/Users` returns **201 even with empty body {}** (validation quirk worth a look).

ffac2d.title: Specialist targets
ffac2d.content:
Prioritized specialist assignments for http://host.docker.internal:3001 (Juice Shop 20.2.0). Recon JWT (customer, id=25/bid=6) at `/workspace/recon_token.txt`; account `tester.recon@juice-sh.op`/`recon123456`. Full inventory: `/workspace/recon_endpoints.txt`.

1. **SQLi agent**: `POST /rest/user/login` (email/password — `' OR 1=1--` classic), `GET /rest/products/search?q=`, `POST /rest/track-order` `{orderId,email}`. Also error pages leak stack traces (Sequelize validation errors).
2. **IDOR/access-control agent**: `GET /rest/basket/:id` (token carries `bid` — try other baskets 1-9), `PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon`, `GET/PUT /api/Addresss/:id`, `/api/Cards/:id`, `/api/SecurityAnswers`, `POST /rest/admin` (with admin role claim), `/rest/order-history` (other users' orders), `/api/Users/:id` GET/PUT.
3. **JWT/auth agent**: JWT is RS256 with public key derivable from `/rest/admin/application-version`? No — but: token has **no exp**; payload embeds password hash + totpSecret; forgeability (alg confusion/none, key confusion via exposed public key in main.js or /api-docs); mass-assignment `role:"admin"` in `POST /api/Users`; `/rest/user/change-password?current=&new=` query-string params; `/rest/user/security-question?email=` enumeration + reset-password answer guessing.
4. **XSS agent**: `GET /rest/products/search?q=` reflection into Angular DOM; `POST /api/Feedbacks` {comment} stored XSS; `POST /rest/memories` {caption} photo wall; product review PUT `/rest/products/:id/reviews` {message,author}; DOM XSS via `redirect` param and hash routing.
5. **SSRF/open-redirect agent**: `GET /redirect?to=` (allowlist bypass), `POST /rest/user/dataerasure` (accepts arbitrary URL?), profile image URL, chatbot LLM.
6. **Business-logic agent**: `PUT /rest/wallet/balance` (arbitrary balance), `PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon` (expired coupon `coupons_2013.md.bak` in /ftp), `POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout` (negative quantities via `/api/Quantitys`), `PUT /rest/products/:id` (price tampering), deluxe-membership race.
7. **Secrets/files agent**: `/ftp` listing (kdbx, encrypt.pyc, .bak files — path traversal `?` tricks e.g. `/ftp/...`), `/package.json.bak`, `/metrics`, unauth `/rest/admin/application-configuration`, `/rest/admin/application-version`.
8. **LLM/prompt-injection agent**: `POST /rest/chat` — chatbot with tool calls (`show_tool_calls` key in localStorage).
9. **2FA/crypto agent**: `/rest/2fa/*` (totpSecret leaked in JWT payload; setup/verify bypass), `/rest/continue-code` forging.

Recon-only caveats: `whoami` needs `token` cookie (not Bearer); `/rest/order-history` blocks requests with a special "Blocked illegal activity" error page; admin API `/rest/admin` returns 500 for unauth/customer (error page, not 403).

c9a4b8.title: Admin JWT obtained via login SQLi — saved to /workspace/admin_token.txt
c9a4b8.content:
Admin JWT for http://host.docker.internal:3001 saved at /workspace/admin_token.txt.

Obtained via SQL injection in POST /rest/user/login email field: email = `' OR 1=1--`, password = any value (e.g. `x`). Returns a valid session for user id 1 (admin@juice-sh.op, role=admin, bid=1).

Verified working: GET /api/Users with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` returns 200 with full user list (admin-only endpoint). Token is RS256, no exp claim, payload embeds full user record including password hash (`0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500` for admin) and totpSecret.

Auth/IDOR/business-logic specialists can reuse this token directly.

6750e5.title: SSRF/Redirect interim: /redirect prefix-match bypass confirmed; dataerasure layout=LFR not SSRF
6750e5.content:
SSRF/Redirect specialist (edb5b696) findings so far:
- `/redirect?to=` allowlist is a PREFIX check on exact allowlisted URL strings. Confirmed allowlisted prefixes (302): `https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop`, `https://blockchain.info/address/1AbKfgvw9psQ41NbLi8kufDQTezwG8DRZm`, plus dash/etherscan explorer URLs. ANY suffix is accepted, including `@evil.com` suffix → real open redirect (browser goes to evil.com host via userinfo). Arbitrary hosts NOT allowed; case tricks, encoding, protocol-relative all rejected.
- `POST /dataerasure` (auth via token COOKIE, not Bearer) supports `layout` param → server-side path traversal/LFR when lfrChallenge enabled (blocked ftp/ctf.key/encryptionkeys paths). NOT SSRF (template render, no outbound request). SSRF challenge key `ssrfChallenge` exists — hidden resource via B2B `/b2b/v2/orders` with customer-specific JSON? Not yet found. B2B orders endpoint: POST /b2b/v2/orders {cid, orderLinesData}.

7208dc.title: IDOR findings + test credentials (access-control specialist)
7208dc.content:
Access-control testing complete on http://host.docker.internal:3001. Two real identities used:
- User A: tester.recon@juice-sh.op (id=25, basket 6), token in /workspace/recon_token.txt
- User B: idor.b.jcgpw4pc@juice-sh.op / IdorTest123! (id=27, basket 7), token+creds in /workspace/idor/creds.json

CONFIRMED cross-user access (attacker = any authenticated customer):
1. GET /rest/basket/:id — read ANY user's basket (verified ids 1-7). Unauth = 401.
2. POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout — checkout another user's basket: victim's basket emptied, order created in attacker's account (orderConfirmation 1531-fb8b8c20545b1aef).
3. PUT /api/Addresss/:id + DELETE — modify/delete another user's saved address; PUT also reassigns UserId to the caller (steals the record). Per-object GET is blocked ("Malicious activity detected"), write is not.
4. GET /api/Users and /api/Users/:id — full user directory to any customer (all 28 emails, roles, admin@juice-sh.op, lastLoginIp). Unauth = 401.
5. GET /api/Complaints — any customer reads all users' complaint messages (incl. B's private complaint).
6. /api/BasketItems — GET lists all users' items; PUT changes quantity of another user's item (1→4 confirmed, victim sees 4); DELETE removes it (confirmed twice). POST with foreign BasketId IS blocked (401 Invalid BasketId).

BLOCKED / ruled out: /api/Cards/:id (all methods blocked cross-user), GET /api/Addresss/:id per-object, PUT /api/Users/:id (401), /api/SecurityAnswers (401), /rest/order-history/orders + delivery-status (403 role check works server-side), PUT /rest/products/:id + POST /rest/admin (route not registered in build, 500 "Unexpected path").

GAP: PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon could not be tested — every coupon (WMNSDY20xx/ORANGE20xx, validOn max 2023) is expired, server 404s before any ownership check.

Unauth /rest/admin/application-configuration verified 200; dump reviewed (saved /workspace/idor/appconfig.json) — no secrets/credentials inside, informational only.

Evidence: /workspace/idor/poc_evidence.txt, scripts /workspace/idor/*.py.

4b1dd5.title: Chatbot LLM backend unreachable — all /rest/chat LLM testing blocked
4b1dd5.content:
POST /rest/chat (Juicy chatbot, gemma4:e4b) is non-functional in this deployment: every valid request (auth or unauth) returns SSE `data: {"error":"LLM error: AI_RetryError: Failed after 3 attempts. Last error: Cannot connect to API: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:11434"}`. The Juice Shop server cannot reach its Ollama LLM backend (host Ollama IS reachable from the test container on host.docker.internal:11434, but the app calls 127.0.0.1:11434 — likely app runs in its own container). /metrics confirms llm_input_tokens_total=0 / llm_output_tokens_total=0 — model never invoked.

Consequences for this scan:
- All LLM01/03/07/08/10 testing (prompt injection, system prompt extraction, coupon tool abuse, indirect injection via reviews, output handling) is UNTESTABLE — no model output can ever be observed. All four surfaces recorded as needs_follow_up (coverage ids 9824f9, ea146a, 760792, fa8ab1).
- Server-side observation: /rest/chat accepts attacker-supplied `system`-role messages in the `messages` array unauthenticated (schema accepts system+assistant+user; rejects `tool` role and non-string content) — once the backend is up this is a ready-made injection primitive.
- Secondary observation (not filed as vuln): the unauthenticated error stream discloses internal infrastructure (LLM API at 127.0.0.1:11434, retry count, Vercel AI SDK error classes). Reconnaissance value only; no data/credential exposure.
- To unblock: run Ollama with model gemma4:e4b reachable at the app's 127.0.0.1:11434 (e.g. ollama serve in the app's network namespace, or set the model provider baseURL), then re-run the chatbot challenge tests. No feedback/reviews were planted (test could not complete).

2c0086.content: Admin JWT (RS256, valid) for account auth.spec.massadm@juice-sh.op / AuthSpec123! (id=28, role=admin), saved at /workspace/admin_token.txt.
